question: Classical Sarod player, Amjad Ali Khan was awarded __________ in 2001 by the Government of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Vibhushan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Amjad Ali Khan is a renowned Indian classical musician who plays the sarod.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2001 by the Government of India.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest civilian award in India, given for exceptional and distinguished service.
 
• Amjad Ali Khan has received numerous other accolades for his contributions to Indian classical music, including the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards**

 
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors of India announced annually on the eve of Republic Day.
 
• They are given in three categories: Padma Vibhushan (for exceptional and distinguished service), Padma Bhushan (for distinguished service of a high order), and Padma Shri (for distinguished service).
 
• Instituted in 1954, these awards recognize achievements in all fields of activities or disciplines where an element of public service is involved.
 
• The awards are conferred by the President of India at ceremonial functions which are held at Rashtrapati Bhawan usually around March/April every year.
 
 
 
• **Sarod**
 
 
• The sarod is a stringed musical instrument used mainly in Indian classical music.
 
• It is known for its deep, weighty, introspective sound, and is an important instrument in the Hindustani classical tradition.
 
• The sarod is believed to have descended from the Afghan rubab.
 
• The instrument has a fretless fingerboard, and it is played with a plectrum.
 
 
 
• **Amjad Ali Khan**
 
 
• Amjad Ali Khan is one of the foremost sarod players in the world.
 
• He was born on October 9, 1945, into a family of musicians. His father, Haafiz Ali Khan, was also a famous sarod player.
 
• Amjad Ali Khan has performed at various prestigious venues around the world and has been honored with numerous awards and titles.
 
• His contributions to Indian classical music have been instrumental in popularizing the sarod globally.
